subject: math

entries: A vector has size and direction: the arrow moves 2 right and 3 up, its column vector records 2 over 3, and the length of the arrow is its magnitude.
slots.label: A vector has size and direction
slots.studentPrompt: Explain this step in your own words.

entries: Adding vectors: tail to head: place the tail of the second vector at the head of the first, and the sum runs from the very first tail to the very last head.
slots.label: Adding vectors
slots.studentPrompt: Explain this step in your own words.

entries: The dot product measures the shadow: drop a perpendicular from the tip of b onto a, and the projection is measured by a . b = |a||b| cos theta.
slots.label: The dot product measures the shadow
slots.studentPrompt: Explain this step in your own words.

entries: Lines and planes from a point and directions: one point plus one direction draws a line, r = a + lambda b; a plane needs two directions and its normal stands perpendicular to the whole surface.
slots.label: Lines and planes from a point and directions
slots.studentPrompt: Explain this step in your own words.

entries: A common mistake: moving a vector changes it: sliding a free vector to a new start point leaves it unchanged - only position vectors are pinned to the origin.
slots.label: A common mistake
slots.studentPrompt: Explain this step in your own words.

entries: A quantity with both magnitude and direction, pictured as an arrow: the arrow for (2, 3) moves 2 right and 3 up.
slots.label: Vector
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

entries: The length of the vector arrow: for (x, y) it is sqrt(x^2 + y^2) by Pythagoras, so |(2, 3)| = sqrt(13).
slots.label: Magnitude
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

entries: The record of a vector as its components stacked in a column: the top entry is the right move and the bottom entry is the up move, as in 2 over 3.
slots.label: Column vector
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

entries: The scalar a . b = |a||b| cos theta, computed component by component; it measures how much of b points along a, and it is zero exactly when the vectors are perpendicular.
slots.label: Dot product
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

entries: The vector of a point measured from the origin: it is pinned to the origin, so moving the point changes its position vector.
slots.label: Position vector
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

entries: A free vector that gives the direction of a line or plane edge: the same arrow drawn anywhere is the same direction vector, as in r = a + lambda b.
slots.label: Direction vector
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

title: JC H2 vectors: direction, dot products, lines and planes
